steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: A payment was recorded by mistake. Here's how to reverse it.

steps.caption: Search for the client
steps.narration: On Clients, search for the client.

steps.caption: Open the client
steps.narration: Click the name to open their page.

steps.caption: The payment
steps.narration: Under Payments, a payment you recorded has a Reverse button.

steps.caption: Nothing is deleted
steps.narration: Nothing is deleted. The payment stays in the history, marked reversed.

steps.caption: Reason
steps.narration: Type the reason. It's kept with the payment.

steps.caption: Marked reversed, with the reason
steps.narration: The payment is still listed, now marked reversed, with who reversed it and why.

steps.caption: Collected to date
steps.narration: Collected to date no longer counts it.

steps.caption: Menu: Payments
steps.narration: The Payments page in the menu lists every payment, with the same Reverse button.

youtube.title: How to reverse a payment recorded by mistake | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of reversing a recorded payment in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will open the client, choose Reverse on the payment, give a reason, and see that the payment stays in the history marked reversed while the collected total updates.
